attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 26 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and its whole entry is one sentence: «Ο Άγιος Ιερομάρτυς Ζαχαρίας ήταν δεύτερος Επίσκοπος της Βιέννης και μαρτύρησε υπέρ Χριστού το 160 μ.Χ.». None of the corpus's men of this name is a bishop of Vienne: `zacharias-of-jerusalem`, `zacharias-of-arta`, `zacharias-father-of-the-forerunner` and the rest are other men. The Vienne meant is the see in Gaul, on the Rhône, not the Austrian city; the page does not say so, and the second-century date and the Latin world it belongs to are what make it plain. No hymn, no relics, no place of burial.
